Sber TVs and SberBox with Salute TV (StarOS)

Developer options don’t appear? Sber has its own switch: sign in to SmartApp Studio at developers.sber.ru with the same Sber ID as on the TV, open “My devices”, add the TV by the serial number from “About” and turn ADB on. The SmartApp section only shows up once your personal space has at least one project — create an empty one. It doesn’t work on every model.

On Salute TV, TVCleanzer disables apps instead of uninstalling them: Sber puts uninstalled ones back. The firmware turns some of them (SberPrime, smart-home ads, provider setup) on again after a restart — just run the clean-up again. TVCleanzer never touches Sber’s app catalogue, the Salute assistant or the HDMI inputs.

First just run a search in TVCleanzer: on some of these TVs network debugging is on from the factory, even though the menu doesn’t show it.
Not found? Open Settings → Picture, highlight Contrast and type 1147 on the remote. Nothing opened — try 9735.
In the service menu that opens, go to Debug (or Other) and turn on ADB Enable. Restart the TV and search again in TVCleanzer.

Code didn’t work or the menu has no ADB: download the small FactoryMenu app (com.stb.factorymenu, from the CVTE boards thread on the 4PDA forum), install it from a USB stick via Files, open it → Debug → ADB Enable.

In the service menu change only ADB: it also holds panel, backlight and factory-mode settings. On these TVs debugging may let anyone on the network in without asking — when you’re done, turn ADB off there or restart the TV.
No colon on the keyboard? Type a dot or a comma after the address — TVCleanzer turns it into “:”.
